mapper.sql: session_id AS id, owner_id AS user_id, viewer_id, conversation_type, topic, created_at, analysis::text, COALESCE((analysis->>'turnCount')::int,0) AS turn_count, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clone_lab.session_messages c WHERE c.session_id=s.session_id AND c.status='pending') THEN 'generated' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clone_lab.session_messages c WHERE c.metadata->>'session_id'=s.session_id::text AND c.status='analyzed') THEN 'analyzed' WHEN COALESCE((analysis->>'turnCount')::int,0)>0 THEN 'saved' ELSE 'generated' END AS status
id, session_id, sequence_no, created_at, status, metadata::text, pair_no::int AS ordinal, user_text, assistant_text
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO clone_lab.context(conversation_id,content,type,timestamp,source_message_id,is_active) SELECT s.memory_key,v.content,v.type,v.received_at,m.id,false FROM clone_lab.session_messages m JOIN clone_lab.sessions s ON s.session_id=m.session_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (m.user_text,'USER',m.user_received_at), (m.assistant_text,'ASSISTANT',m.assistant_received_at) ) AS v(content,type,received_at) WHERE m.session_id=#{session} AND m.pair_no > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(segment_no)*20 FROM clone_lab.context_summaries WHERE session_id=#{session}),0) ON CONFLICT (source_message_id,type) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE clone_lab.context c SET is_active=COALESCE(c.source_message_id IN ( SELECT id FROM clone_lab.session_messages WHERE session_id=#{session} ORDER BY pair_no DESC LIMIT 20),false) WHERE c.conversation_id=CAST(#{session} AS varchar) AND c.is_active IS DISTINCT FROM (c.source_message_id IN ( SELECT id FROM clone_lab.session_messages WHERE session_id=#{session} ORDER BY pair_no DESC LIMIT 20))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM clone_lab.context c USING clone_lab.session_messages m WHERE c.source_message_id=m.id AND m.session_id=#{session} AND NOT c.is_active AND m.pair_no <= COALESCE((SELECT MAX(segment_no)*20 FROM clone_lab.context_summaries WHERE session_id=#{session}),0)
DELETE FROM clone_lab.context_summaries WHERE session_id=#{session} AND segment_no > #{blocks}
mapper.select: SELECT id,pair_no,user_text,assistant_text FROM clone_lab.session_messages WHERE session_id=#{id} ORDER BY pair_no
SELECT id,session_id,segment_no,start_message_id,end_message_id,content FROM clone_lab.context_summaries WHERE session_id=#{id} ORDER BY segment_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO clone_lab.context_summaries(session_id,segment_no,start_message_id,end_message_id,content) VALUES(#{session},#{segment},#{start},#{end},#{content}) ON CONFLICT(session_id,segment_no) DO NOTHING

mapper.update: UPDATE clone_lab.users SET profile_version=profile_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND profile_version=#{version}

llm_elapsed_ms,wall_elapsed_ms,retry_count,config,state,active_since,heartbeat_at,finished_at) SELECT (j->>'runId')::bigint,#{id},(j->>'batchId')::bigint,j->>'mode',j->>'topic', (j->>'status')::clone_lab.run_status,j->>'error', COALESCE((j->>'targetPairs')::int,1000),COALESCE((j->>'generatedPairs')::int,0), COALESCE((j->>'analyzedPairs')::int,0),COALESCE((j->>'savedPairs')::int,0), COALESCE((j->>'inputTokens')::bigint,0),COALESCE((j->>'outputTokens')::bigint,0), COALESCE((j->>'cachedTokens')::bigint,0),COALESCE((j->>'llmElapsedMs')::bigint,0), COALESCE((j->>'wallElapsedMs')::bigint,0),COALESCE((j->>'retryCount')::int,0), CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(j->'config')='object' THEN j->'config' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END, j-ARRAY['runId','batchId','mode','topic','status','error','targetPairs','generatedPairs', 'analyzedPairs','savedPairs','inputTokens','outputTokens','cachedTokens','llmElapsedMs', 'elapsedMs','wallElapsedMs','retryCount','activeSince','heartbeatAt','config'], CASE WHEN j->>'status' IN ('running','stopping') THEN COALESCE(to_timestamp((j->>'activeSince')::double precision/1000),clock_timestamp()) END, COALESCE(to_timestamp((j->>'heartbeatAt')::double precision/1000),clock_timestamp()), CASE WHEN j->>'status' IN ('completed','cancelled') THEN clock_timestamp() END FROM (SELECT CAST(#{state} AS jsonb) j) input ON CONFLICT(run_id) DO UPDATE SET status=EXCLUDED.status,error=EXCLUDED.error, generated_pairs=EXCLUDED.generated_pairs,analyzed_pairs=EXCLUDED.analyzed_pairs, saved_pairs=EXCLUDED.saved_pairs,input_tokens=EXCLUDED.input_tokens, output_tokens=EXCLUDED.output_tokens,cached_tokens=EXCLUDED.cached_tokens, llm_elapsed_ms=EXCLUDED.llm_elapsed_ms,wall_elapsed_ms=EXCLUDED.wall_elapsed_ms, retry_count=EXCLUDED.retry_count,state=EXCLUDED.state,active_since=EXCLUDED.active_since, heartbeat_at=EXCLUDED.heartbeat_at,finished_at=EXCLUDED.finished_at

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO clone_lab.vector_store(owner_id,source_session_record_id,content,embedding,metadata) SELECT s.owner_id,m.id,m.content,m.embedding,m.metadata || jsonb_build_object('record_type','conversation_archive', 'source_ids',jsonb_build_array(m.id::text), 'source_excerpts',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('source_id',m.id::text,'user_text',m.user_text))) FROM clone_lab.session_messages m JOIN clone_lab.sessions s ON s.session_id=m.session_id WHERE m.id=#{id} AND m.status='saved' AND m.embedding IS NOT NULL AND s.conversation_type='owner' ON CONFLICT(source_session_record_id) DO NOTHING
